marketing_description: The NUVO® Direct Wire Downlight (part 62-1787) from SATCO’s Contractor Select collection provides 24 W of input power to a 75 W LED source delivering 2000 lm at selectable color temperatures from 2700 K to 5000 K with a CRI of 90. Housed in a white steel round fixture with a frosted polycarbonate lens, the recessed trim (5‑6 in opening, 4 in trim size) is IP20 rated, air‑tight, IC rated and includes a remote driver for dimmable operation and a 90° beam angle. The unit mounts to the ceiling with a standard E26 base bulb included.
